emerging_watch: Watching whether Base Metals & Copper closes the narrow 0.075 leadership margin versus Big Banks and prints as confirmed leader while Big Banks stays crowded; the watch ends if Big Banks widens its margin back above 0.20 or Base Metals drops out of the top 3.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners show the cleanest staying-power profile among scorable leaders: eligible on the absolute-trend gate, highest durability_bar (0.82), hurst_tag trend, full breadth (1.0), and not crowded. theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
